description: Xun Yu, upright chinese minister in the supplied pixel art style. A tall black hat with gold bands, a long cream robe with wide sleeves and gold trim, a long blue and gold sash hanging down the front. He holds a narrow gold ceremonial tablet upright in front of his chest
face: A calm dignified face, no beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the tall black and gold hat, the plain cream robe with a gold belt. What he holds is in front of the body and hidden.
guard_action: the right hand lifts what it holds up beside the right shoulder, the left hand lowers, the left foot settles half a step forward

actions.idle: Calm ready stance holding the ceremonial tablet up, breathing
actions.move: Brisk walk in place with small steps, robe swaying, ceremonial tablet held up, seamless loop. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Upward flick. Frames 3-6 the knees bend and the ceremonial tablet is lowered in front; frames 7-8 the body straightens up tall and it is flicked from below to high above the head; frames 9-11 hold high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The ceremonial tablet stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Downward stroke. Frames 3-6 he stands tall and raises the ceremonial tablet above the head; frames 7-8 he drops into a deep knee bend and draws it straight down in front; frames 9-11 hold low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The ceremonial tablet stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Wide sweeping release. Frames 3-6 the ceremonial tablet is wound to the left chest; frame 7 the left foot steps out; frame 8 it is swept wide to the right; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The ceremonial tablet stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s3: Open-armed blessing. Frames 3-6 both hands gather low in front of the chest and he bows; frame 8 he rises and spreads both arms wide and up to the sides; frames 9-12 hold. Feet stay in place. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The ceremonial tablet stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → b2 → a3, 전법 s3. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
